name: Push-up
instructions: Start in a plank with hands shoulder-width. Lower chest to the floor keeping body in a straight line, then press back up.
form_cue: Squeeze glutes and brace core — no hip sag.
common_mistakes: Flared elbows; hips dropping; partial range of motion.

name: Incline push-up
instructions: Place hands on a sturdy bench or counter. Lower chest to the edge, then press up.
form_cue: The higher the surface, the easier — regress as needed.
common_mistakes: Letting lower back arch; rushing reps.

name: Decline push-up
instructions: Feet elevated on bench, hands on floor shoulder-width. Lower chest then press up. Biases upper chest.
form_cue: Keep core tight; don't dump hips toward the floor.

name: Diamond push-up
instructions: Place hands together forming a diamond under chest. Lower and press up with elbows close to body.
common_mistakes: Going too deep if shoulders are tight.

name: Dumbbell bench press
instructions: Lie on bench, dumbbells at chest. Press straight up until arms lock, lower under control.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
instructions: Seated or standing, dumbbells at shoulder height. Press overhead until arms straight, lower to ears.
form_cue: Don't arch lower back — keep ribs down.

name: Dumbbell lateral raise
instructions: Standing, slight elbow bend. Raise arms out to sides until parallel to floor. Lower slowly.
common_mistakes: Using too much weight and swinging.

name: Pike push-up
instructions: Downward-dog position with hips high. Lower crown of head toward floor between hands, then press up.
form_cue: Hips high; push floor away at top.
common_mistakes: Letting hips drop into a push-up position.

name: Chair dip
instructions: Hands on chair edge behind you, feet out. Lower body by bending elbows, then press up.
form_cue: Elbows back, not out. Keep chest up.

name: Overhead tricep extension
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands. Lower behind head by bending elbows, then extend up.
form_cue: Keep elbows tucked by your ears.

name: Bent-over dumbbell row
instructions: Hinge at hips with flat back, dumbbells hanging. Row to lower ribs, squeeze shoulder blades, lower.

name: Single-arm dumbbell row
instructions: Knee + hand on bench, opposite hand rows dumbbell to hip, squeezing lat.
form_cue: Drive elbow past ribs; no twist.

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
instructions: Dumbbells in front of thighs. Push hips back, lower weights along legs until tension in hamstrings, drive hips forward.
form_cue: Soft knees; lats tight; hinge not squat.

name: Dumbbell curl
instructions: Arms at sides, palms forward. Curl up without swinging torso, squeeze top, lower slow.

name: Hammer curl
instructions: Neutral grip (thumbs up). Curl both arms, control the descent.

name: Reverse fly
instructions: Hinge at hips with light dumbbells. Raise arms out to sides, pinching shoulder blades.
form_cue: Lead with elbows; pause at top.

name: Pull-up
instructions: Overhand grip, shoulder-width. Pull until chin clears bar, lower fully.
form_cue: Drive elbows down to your back pockets.

name: Inverted row
instructions: Lie under a bar/table edge, grip, pull chest to bar keeping body straight.

name: Band face-pull
instructions: Anchor band at face height. Pull toward forehead, externally rotating shoulders, elbows high.
common_mistakes: Pulling to chest instead of face.

name: Superman
instructions: Lie face down, arms extended. Lift chest, arms, and legs simultaneously; hold, lower.

name: Bodyweight squat
instructions: Feet shoulder-width. Sit hips back and down until thighs parallel, drive through heels to stand.
form_cue: Knees track over toes; chest up.

name: Goblet squat
instructions: Hold dumbbell at chest. Squat down keeping elbows inside knees, stand tall.

name: Walking lunge
instructions: Step forward to 90° front knee, back knee hovering. Drive through front heel into next step.

name: Bulgarian split squat
instructions: Rear foot on bench, front foot forward. Squat down until front thigh parallel, drive up.
common_mistakes: Front foot too close to bench.

name: Glute bridge
instructions: Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat. Drive hips up until body is straight line, squeeze glutes.

name: Hip thrust
instructions: Upper back on bench, weight on hips. Drive hips up to full extension, pause, lower.
form_cue: Chin tucked; ribs down at top.

name: Calf raise
instructions: Stand tall, rise onto balls of feet, squeeze calves, lower slowly.

name: Wall sit
instructions: Back against wall, thighs parallel to floor. Hold for time.

name: Jump squat
instructions: Squat down, explode up into a jump, land soft back into squat.
form_cue: Land with soft knees, not stiff.

name: Step-up
instructions: Step one foot onto bench, drive through heel to stand, step back down controlled.

name: Burpee
instructions: Squat, hands down, kick feet back to plank, optional push-up, jump feet in, leap up.

name: Mountain climber
instructions: Plank position. Alternate driving knees to chest rapidly.

name: Jumping jack
instructions: Jump feet out while raising arms overhead; jump back.

name: High knees
instructions: Run in place driving knees to hip height. Pump arms.

name: Squat jump
instructions: Squat, explode up vertically, land soft back into squat immediately.

name: Skater jump
instructions: Bound laterally from one leg to the other, tapping non-weight foot behind.
form_cue: Land soft with knee tracking over toe.

name: Dumbbell thruster
instructions: Front squat with dumbbells at shoulders. Stand explosively and press dumbbells overhead.
form_cue: Use leg drive into the press.

name: Renegade row
instructions: Plank on dumbbells, row one up to hip, lower, alternate. Keep hips square.

name: Dumbbell swing
instructions: Hinge hips, swing dumbbell between legs; snap hips to drive it to shoulder height.

name: Bear crawl
instructions: Hands and knees, knees hovering 2 inches. Crawl forward moving opposite hand + foot.

name: Jumping rope
instructions: Small hops on balls of feet, wrists rotate the rope.
form_cue: Wrists do the work, not arms.

name: Shadow boxing
instructions: Stance set. Throw jabs, crosses, hooks with rotation from hips and feet.
form_cue: Return hands to guard every punch.

name: Running in place
instructions: Jog in place at a moderate tempo, driving knees and swinging arms.

name: Plank
instructions: Forearms on floor, body straight from head to heels. Hold for time.

name: Side plank
instructions: Forearm on floor, stack feet, lift hips to a straight line from head to feet.

name: Russian twist
instructions: Sit back at 45°, feet off floor. Rotate torso side-to-side, tapping floor each side.

name: Leg raise
instructions: Lie on back, legs straight. Raise to 90°, lower slowly without touching floor.

name: Dead bug
instructions: Lie on back, arms and legs up. Lower opposite arm and leg to floor, return, alternate.
form_cue: Lower back stays pinned to floor.

name: Bird dog
instructions: On hands and knees, extend opposite arm and leg. Pause, return, alternate.

name: Bicycle crunch
instructions: Lie on back, hands behind head. Alternate bringing opposite elbow to opposite knee.
